svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Untied B8, weight-shared C8 and hybrid H8: same executed depth, different parameter sharing
svg.desc: Three matched pipelines. Each encodes a 3 by 32 by 32 image with a stride-2 convolution to a 32-channel state, applies eight residual convolutional updates, and reads out 100 class logits. B8 uses eight distinct weight sets W1 to W8; C8 reuses a single weight set W at all eight updates; H8 uses its own block A at update 1, one shared block S at updates 2 to 7, and its own block Z at update 8. All execute 37,973,120 multiply-accumulates; B8 has 152,644 parameters, C8 has 22,724 and H8 has 59,844. H8 is an exploratory follow-up. A validation-only position ablation compares END (the same A, S, Z map) with INNER, whose two independent blocks sit at updates 2 and 7.
svg.text: Equal executed depth, different parameter sharing
Width 32 · eight residual updates, each adding 0.1 · F(h) to the state h · F = (GroupNorm, ReLU, 3×3 conv) applied twice, 8 groups
eight successive blocks, each with its own weights
8 distinct weight sets · 8 × 18,560 branch parameters · 4,718,592 MACs per update
one block, applied at all eight updates
same tensor W reused 8× · 18,560 branch parameters · 4,718,592 MACs per update
own block A at update 1, one shared block S at updates 2–7, own block Z at update 8
3 distinct weight sets · 3 × 18,560 branch parameters · 4,718,592 MACs per update
Exploratory follow-up, proposed after the original B/C/E test results were known; reuses the frozen B8/C8 controls. 59,844 parameters.
Position ablation (validation only): END uses this map [A,S,S,S,S,S,S,Z]; INNER = [S,A,S,S,S,S,Z,S], independent blocks at updates 2 and 7. Both 59,844 parameters.
C8 stores ≈ 6.7× fewer parameters than B8;
8 branch applications in B8, C8 and H8
Counts convolutions and head only; GroupNorm,
ReLU, residual add, pooling and memory traffic
are omitted. No latency claim is made.
Shared block + recall of the stem state
Counts come from recorded run metadata (seed 11, executed depth 8, width 32). B8, C8 and H8 share the same stem, readout and executed depth.
